column1: # Shared virtualenv-forwarding vectors (#729). `lang` requests carry a
# `virtual_env` value chosen from the shell environment: $VIRTUAL_ENV wins;
# otherwise $CONDA_PREFIX, but only when $CONDA_DEFAULT_ENV is non-empty and
# not `base` (a forwarded venv beats the project's .venv, and many setups
# auto-activate conda base everywhere). Empty expected value = nothing is
# forwarded. Read by ALL FOUR implementations so they cannot drift apart:
#   - Rust:  resolve_python_venv precedence for the forwarded value
# Format: one vector per line, tab-separated:
# Blank lines and lines starting with # are ignored. The token \e in a column
# means the EMPTY string (an empty column would be collapsed by bash/zsh
# `read`); an empty value and an unset variable are treated alike. No other
# escapes are used. Every reader MUST fail if this file is missing or yields
